drawings.description: dessiné dans la marge : un arc $\varphi_G$ va de la dernière colonne à la première au-dessus du rang supérieur ; « cart. » est écrit dans le carré de gauche ; sous les deux $S$ : « $= \mathrm{Spec}(k)$ » et « $\lambda \mapsto \lambda^{p^n}$ »
drawings.kind: marginal commutative diagram with an arc phi_G
drawings.notes: The margin diagram of the transcription (G <- G^(p^n) <- G over S <- S, with p, F^n, pr_1, phi_S), redrawn with its arc phi_G from the last column to the first above the top row, "cart." in the left square, and under the two S the signs "=" with Spec(k) and lambda |-> lambda^{p^n}. The label of the left top arrow looks like "p^n" on the crop; it is placed as the transcription reads it (pr_1).

drawings.description: feuillet de croquis écrit en tous sens (la page se lit tournée d'un quart de tour), couvert de flèches, de cadres et de traits de renvoi, en partie barré. On n'en donne que les fragments lisibles, dans l'ordre du haut vers le bas
drawings.kind: sheet of sketches written in all directions
drawings.notes: Whole sheet, kept in page orientation; coordinates re-read on two tight views of the sheet, labels at \small (drawing at 2 mm per crop unit, about the size of the sheet). Drawn: the two heavy arrows G -> G' (the upper one followed by a second heavy arrow), Hom(... k'; G) = G' at the top, G and R_1 subset G_1, the extension k_0(t^{1/p}) | k_0(t), R'; the small frame below the lower G -> G'; L_1 = L' (fraktur, as in the transcription), the double cone beside it, the brackets of [B_0 = B'_0] (the right one heavy), B, B' contains T, and the long frame open on the left that holds all three; the arrow marked ? down to B = B'; en car. different from 2, 3, 5 (underlined) and O.K.; the boxed L = L' (its right side heavy); the frame at the bottom right that holds the marginal note; in the left columns the heavy arrows read as the Uparrow (drawn pointing left, as on the unturned sheet), the Updownarrow, and a double arrow pointing left at the bottom. Left out: all the text written along the turned sheet and the formulas H^1(...) (they are in the transcription), the long reference lines and the large arcs crossing the sheet, the struck parts (the scribble under the lower G -> G', the hatched arrow at the bottom left, the struck words), the heavy isolated letters (B, R, H, G g B near the right edge, H1 at the left of the double cone) which the transcription does not read, and the contents of the small frame. Still differs: a whole page with its reference lines omitted; positions read on views of half the sheet, drift of 1 to 2 units likely. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Question closed by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (no consequence): the mark itself says that only the legible fragments of this scratch sheet are given; the choice of what is left out (reference lines, turned text, the isolated heavy letters) does not change any figure. Not checked by a reader. 2026-11-14, Claude Opus 5.5, overlay check (issue 147): rasterised from its own coordinates over the 400 dpi colour scan of the whole sheet and measured (every stroke within 0.4 unit of its ink on average, every label centred on ink); not compiled (no TeX in the session). The drift of 1 to 2 units feared above is not there: the arrows, the boxes, the hourglass, the frames and the labels of the fragments lie on the page where they are drawn. What is left out (reference lines, turned text, isolated heavy letters) is the choice the mark itself makes for this scratch sheet. Status set to ok.

drawings.description: en haut à droite, un petit dessin barré portant « $x^2 = a$ », « $x^2 - a + y^2 = 0$ » et « $x/t$ »
drawings.notes: The vertical stroke (slightly curved) and, to its right, the three formulas as the transcription reads them: x^2 = a, x^2 - a + y^2 = 0, x/t, at \small. The whole sketch is struck through with zigzags and loops; following the convention, the strike-out is not drawn. Still differs: the overinked mark at the top of the stroke (an arrowhead or a letter, like an A) and the heavily overinked label to the left of the stroke at the height of the second formula (x^4 ?) are not read and are left out. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): yes, the sketch is struck: one zigzag runs from the mark at the top of the stroke down across the three formulas; only the vertical stroke itself is not crossed. The strike is not drawn; the formulas and the stroke are kept as before (if wholly struck sketches are to be recorded with an empty redraw, this one qualifies). Not checked by a reader. 2026-11-14, Claude Opus 5.5, overlay check (issue 147): rasterised from its own coordinates over the 400 dpi colour scan on a unit grid; not compiled (no TeX in the session). The vertical stroke lies on its ink, and the three formulas are now centred on their writing (they were 1 to 2.5 units off). Since the sketch is struck (settled on 12 November) and the editor's standing rule is that struck figures are recorded as struck, the stroke and the three formulas are now drawn in the struck style; the zigzag of the strike itself is not drawn. Still differs, and why it stays partial: the overinked mark at the top of the stroke (an arrowhead or a letter like A) and the heavily overinked label left of the stroke at the height of the second formula (x^4 ?) are struck and not legible, and are left out. If the editor prefers wholly struck sketches without a redraw, as he decided for crossings-out, the mark of p. 78 would become struck text in the transcription.

drawings.description: à gauche des formules, sous $\lambda$, un petit carré tracé à main levée, ses quatre côtés ne se joignant pas aux coins ; un point au-dessus de son coin supérieur gauche.
drawings.kind: small freehand square with a point
drawings.notes: A small square drawn freehand as four separate strokes that do not meet at the corners (left, top, right, bottom), drawn as on the page; a full point above its upper left corner. The lambda above and the formulas to the right are text and are not drawn. Nothing struck. Id 04-2 although the mark precedes that of 04-1 (p. 78) in the batch: existing ids are not renumbered. Overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on a 400 dpi colour render: the redraw matches the page; nothing corrected. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à droite, dans le sens de la feuille : un long trait vertical que coupe un trait horizontal épais terminé à droite par un gros point ; à côté, un petit signe (un trait vertical barré d'un tiret).
drawings.kind: two crossed strokes (axes) with an end point
drawings.notes: Drawn in the orientation of the scan (this part of the sheet is written turned a quarter turn, so in reading position the figure is turned likewise). A long thin vertical stroke; across it a heavy horizontal stroke, longer on the right, ending on the right in a full point; the two meet at one computed point. To the right, a small sign: a short vertical stroke with a cross-tick, which is probably the « t » of the « ad t » that the note of the transcription reads here; it is drawn as strokes, not as a letter. Nothing struck. Id 04-3 although the mark precedes that of 04-1 (p. 78) in the batch: existing ids are not renumbered. Overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on a 400 dpi colour render: the redraw matches the page; nothing corrected. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
